description: Phase FRP-7 V1.5 schema metric. Exercises the v2.3.4 mode-aware schema (exposure_mode + public_risk_tags[] + origin_risk_tags[]) end-to-end through validator (relaypackvalidate) → importer (Tauri preview_bundle) → store (engine route directory) → selector (FRP-3 pipeline) → UI (FRP-6 recipient screens). At V1.5 every candidate is exposure_mode=direct_vps. Asserts: (a) RP021 freshness-url-empty enforced; (b) cdn_fronted-only rules (e.g. cdn:* cooldown propagation) are inert no-ops; (c) the FRP-7 rotation recommender returns 'no cdn_fronted candidates available at V1.5' when invoked on a synthetic cdn_fronted exposure_mode input.
